company.description: International Spearfishing Academy is a provider of structured training programs designed for spearfishing enthusiasts. The Academy’s programs focus on teaching effective and safe spearfishing techniques while emphasizing environmental awareness and the protection of marine ecosystems. In addition, the Academy offers formal certification upon completion of its courses, enabling individuals to receive professional training and participate in the sport responsibly and confidently.
